task_completion.description: The agent opens the draft_manifest.csv file on the Desktop to identify the 5 chemicals and their listed classes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A spreadsheet or text editor window showing draft_manifest.csv with 5 rows of chemical data.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the CAMEO Chemicals website and searches for the chemicals using their UN Numbers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A web browser showing the CAMEO Chemicals search page or search results for UN Numbers like 1203 or 1824.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies the official DOT Hazard Class for each chemical from the CAMEO database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser screenshots showing the 'DOT Hazard Label' or 'Hazard Class' section for the searched UN numbers (e.g., Class 3 for UN 1203).

task_completion.description: The agent creates the manifest_audit_report.csv file in the Documents folder with the required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer showing manifest_audit_report.csv in ~/Documents or a text editor/spreadsheet app with the file open.

task_completion.description: The final report contains all 5 items with correct UN Numbers, Listed Classes, Official Classes, and PASS/FAIL statuses based on strict matching.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A view of the final CSV showing 5 rows. Specifically: UN 1203 must show Official Class '3', Listed Class '5.1', and Status 'FAIL'; UN 1824 must show Official Class '8', Listed Class '8', and Status 'PASS'.

integrity.description: The agent used the web browser GUI to find information rather than just guessing or using terminal-based scraping if not specified.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser window active and navigating the CAMEO Chemicals website.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the ground truth into a file without visiting the source website.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows a sequence of searching each UN number individually on the NOAA website.

integrity.description: The agent correctly applied strict matching as requested in the prompt.
integrity.visual_evidence: The audit report shows 'FAIL' for any discrepancy between the listed and official class, even if they are sub-classes.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For UN 1203 (Gasoline): Official Class is '3', Listed Class is '5.1', Status must be 'FAIL'. For UN 1824 (Sodium hydroxide solution): Official Class is '8', Listed Class is '8', Status must be 'PASS'. The final report must be at ~/Documents/manifest_audit_report.csv and contain exactly 5 entries with columns: UN_Number, Listed_Class, Official_Class, and Status.
